department: Max Planck School of Photonics (integrated MSc/PhD or PhD-only)

deadline.value: Dec 1, 2026 for 2027 entry (application and referee invitations); referees must respond by Dec 15
deadline.quote: It will be open until December 1, 2026 for the take-ins in 2027. | For referee invitation December 1 | For referee response December 15

gre_subject.value: Not mentioned separately; the FAQ says the GRE test is not required

supervisor.value: Study-phase entrants find a supervisor during the master's; research-phase applicants list up to five research topics
supervisor.quote: If you start the program in the Study Phase you will be able to find an appropriate supervisor for internships and your Master's thesis during the course of the study.

funding.value: Full funding for up to five years: a stipend (about €1,565 net) in the study phase, then a TVöD/TV-L E13 contract in the research phase; no tuition fees
funding.quote: Admission to a Max Planck School includes full funding for up to five years.

entry_route.value: Bachelor's graduates enter a 2-year study phase (master's) then a 3-year PhD; master's graduates can apply for the PhD (research phase) only
entry_route.quote: a two-year study phase in which you obtain your master's and simultaneously lay the groundwork for your PhD, and a second, three-year research phase | If you have previously completed a master's degree in the field of photonics or similar, you may as well solely apply for the PhD program.

gre_general.value: Not required, and not evaluated if you upload it
gre_general.quote: Do I need proof of the GRE-test? | The test is not required and will not be evaluated by us if you upload it.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL above 70 or IELTS above 6.0 (CEFR B2)

english_waiver.value: A statement from your exam office that your previous degree was taught and examined solely in English is accepted as proof
english_waiver.quote: Statement from an academic examination office that you completed/are completing a previous degree program where the medium of instruction and examination was solely English

notes: Apply to the study phase (bachelor's holders) or the research phase (master's holders); you may apply for both. You are no longer eligible if you secure PhD funding from another source. FAU Erlangen, one of the three teaching universities, charges non-EU applicants a €100 application fee per application for its master's enrolment.
name: Max Planck Schools (Jena, Erlangen and Karlsruhe network)
